title: English Lost 30 Points Of The Early Web
hook: Search only in English and nearly half the web disappears.
closing: The internet still uses English most, but its fastest growth now comes from elsewhere.
question: Which language do you browse in?

segments.say: English fell to 45% of web pages by 2005. The early internet stopped being overwhelmingly English.
Arabic content grew 2,501%. Other languages expanded far faster as new populations came online.
English now appears on 55% of websites. It still leads, but nearly half the web speaks something else.
